answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like a jetty that lets only one boat dock per berth: one identity, one bond. Spawning a thousand fake agents then means locking a thousand bonds, so the cost sends a ripple through every copy instead of staying cheap at the margin. Honest agents get the stake back after verified work on a public terrace of attestations, while proven cheaters forfeit theirs. The defense is economic, not a blacklist.
